title: autobott APT package entry
description: One file per app under packages/. References the .deb artifacts for the app's current version; the publish CI downloads and verifies them.

name.description: Debian package name (must match the .deb's Package field).

version.description: Package version (must match the .deb's Version field).

arch.description: Debian architecture (must match the .deb's Architecture field). "all" is an architecture-independent package; apt-ftparchive includes it in every architecture's index.

url.description: Direct HTTPS download URL of the .deb (e.g. a GitHub Release asset).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the .deb; verified after download.
